// core/trystero-client.js
import { joinRoom } from 'trystero';
import { TRYSTERO_PASSWORD, APP_NAME } from './config.js';

export class SignalingService {
    constructor() {
        this.rooms = new Map();
        this.peers = new Map();
        this.listeners = new Map();
        this.username = null;
        this.typingTimers = new Map();
    }

    setUser(username) {
        this.username = username;
    }

    joinRoom(roomId) {
        if (this.rooms.has(roomId)) return this.rooms.get(roomId);

        const room = joinRoom(APP_NAME, roomId, {
            password: TRYSTERO_PASSWORD,
            username: this.username || 'anonymous'
        });

        this.rooms.set(roomId, room);

        room.on('peer-join', (peerId) => {
            console.log(`馃懁 Peer joined ${roomId}: ${peerId}`);
            this.emit('peer-join', roomId, peerId);
        });

        room.on('peer-leave', (peerId) => {
            console.log(`馃憢 Peer left ${roomId}: ${peerId}`);
            this.emit('peer-leave', roomId, peerId);
        });

        room.on('message', (data, from) => {
            // 袨斜褉邪斜芯褌泻邪 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈泄
            if (data.type === 'typing') {
                this.handleTyping(roomId, data, from);
            } else {
                this.emit('message', roomId, data, from);
            }
        });

        room.on('signal', (data, from) => {
            this.emit('signal', roomId, data, from);
        });

        this.peers.set(roomId, new Set());
        room.getPeers().then(peers => {
            const peerSet = this.peers.get(roomId) || new Set();
            peers.forEach(p => peerSet.add(p));
            this.peers.set(roomId, peerSet);
        });

        return room;
    }

    leaveRoom(roomId) {
        const room = this.rooms.get(roomId);
        if (room) {
            room.leave();
            this.rooms.delete(roomId);
            this.peers.delete(roomId);
            if (this.typingTimers.has(roomId)) {
                clearTimeout(this.typingTimers.get(roomId));
                this.typingTimers.delete(roomId);
            }
        }
    }

    sendMessage(roomId, data) {
        const room = this.rooms.get(roomId);
        if (room) {
            room.send('message', data);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    sendSignal(roomId, data) {
        const room = this.rooms.get(roomId);
        if (room) {
            room.send('signal', data);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    sendTyping(roomId, isTyping) {
        this.sendMessage(roomId, {
            type: 'typing',
            from: this.username,
            isTyping: isTyping,
            timestamp: Date.now()
        });
    }

    handleTyping(roomId, data, from) {
        if (data.from === this.username) return;
        this.emit('typing', roomId, data, from);
    }

    async getPeers(roomId) {
        const room = this.rooms.get(roomId);
        if (room) {
            const peers = await room.getPeers();
            const peerSet = this.peers.get(roomId) || new Set();
            peers.forEach(p => peerSet.add(p));
            this.peers.set(roomId, peerSet);
            return Array.from(peerSet);
        }
        return [];
    }

    on(event, callback) {
        if (!this.listeners.has(event)) {
            this.listeners.set(event, []);
        }
        this.listeners.get(event).push(callback);
    }

    off(event, callback) {
        if (this.listeners.has(event)) {
            const callbacks = this.listeners.get(event);
            const index = callbacks.indexOf(callback);
            if (index > -1) callbacks.splice(index, 1);
        }
    }

    emit(event, ...args) {
        if (this.listeners.has(event)) {
            for (const callback of this.listeners.get(event)) {
                try {
                    callback(...args);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('鉂� Event handler error:', error);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

export async function runAIVerification() {

            // Fallback: 锌褉芯胁械褉褟械屑 褔械褉械蟹 Web API

// ONNX 胁械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈褟
async function runONNXVerification() {
    if (!session) {
        return { passed: false, confidence: 0, details: { error: '袦芯写械谢褜 薪械 蟹邪谐褉褍卸械薪邪' } };
    }

    try {
        // 袙 褉械邪谢褜薪芯褋褌懈 蟹写械褋褜 斜褍写械褌 褉邪斜芯褌邪 褋 泻邪屑械褉芯泄 懈 屑懈泻褉芯褎芯薪芯屑
        // 袛谢褟 写械屑芯薪褋褌褉邪褑懈懈 懈褋锌芯谢褜蟹褍械屑 褌械褋褌芯胁褘械 写邪薪薪褘械
        const inputData = new Float32Array(512).fill(0.5);
        const tensor = new ort.Tensor('float32', inputData, [1, 512]);
        
        const results = await session.run({ input: tensor });
        const output = results.output.data;
        
        const passed = output[0] > 0.5;

    }
}

// Fallback 胁械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈褟
async function fallbackVerification() {
    // 袩褉芯胁械褉褟械屑 写芯褋褌褍锌 泻 泻邪屑械褉械 懈 屑懈泻褉芯褎芯薪褍
    let hasCamera = false;
    let hasMicrophone = false;
    
    try {
        const devices = await navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices();
        hasCamera = devices.some(d => d.kind === 'videoinput');
        hasMicrophone = devices.some(d => d.kind === 'audioinput');
    } catch {
        // 袧械褌 写芯褋褌褍锌邪 泻 屑械写懈邪-褍褋褌褉芯泄褋褌胁邪屑
    }

    // 袩褉芯褋褌邪褟 锌褉芯胁械褉泻邪: 薪邪谢懈褔懈械 泻邪屑械褉褘 懈 屑懈泻褉芯褎芯薪邪
    const passed = hasCamera && hasMicrophone;
    
    return {
        passed,
        confidence: passed ? 0.7 : 0.1,
        details: {
            hasCamera,
            hasMicrophone,
            method: 'fallback'
        }
    };
}

function checkReady() {

// 啸械褕懈褉芯胁邪薪懈械 锌邪褉芯谢褟
export function hashPassword(password, salt) {
    checkReady();
    if (sodium) {
        return sodium.crypto_pwhash(
            32,
            password,
            salt,
            sodium.crypto_pwhash_OPSLIMIT_MODERATE,
            sodium.crypto_pwhash_MEMLIMIT_MODERATE,
            sodium.crypto_pwhash_ALG_ARGON2ID13
        );
    }
    // Fallback SHA-256
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    const data = encoder.encode(password + String.fromCharCode(...salt));
    return crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data).then(hash => new Uint8Array(hash));
}

export function generateSalt() {
    checkReady();
    if (sodium) {
        return sodium.randombytes_buf(sodium.crypto_pwhash_SALTBYTES);
    }
    return crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
}

export function verifyPassword(password, hash, salt) {
    checkReady();
    if (sodium) {
        const computedHash = hashPassword(password, salt);
        return sodium.memcmp(hash, computedHash);
    }
    // Fallback 褋褉邪胁薪械薪懈械 褏械褕械泄
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    const data = encoder.encode(password + String.fromCharCode(...salt));
    return crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data).then(hash2 => {
        const h1 = new Uint8Array(hash);
        const h2 = new Uint8Array(hash2);
        return h1.length === h2.length && h1.every((v, i) => v === h2[i]);
    });
}

// 校褌懈谢懈褌褘
export function serializeHash(hash) {
    return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...hash));
}

export function deserializeHash(serialized) {
    const binary = atob(serialized);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
        bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return bytes;
}

export function serializeSalt(salt) {
    return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...salt));
}

export function deserializeSalt(serialized) {
    const binary = atob(serialized);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
        bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return bytes;

function checkReady() {
    if (!isReady) throw new Error('ChaCha20 薪械 懈薪懈褑懈邪谢懈蟹懈褉芯胁邪薪');

// 楔懈褎褉芯胁邪薪懈械
export function encryptChaCha20(message, key, nonce) {
    checkReady();
    if (sodium) {
        return sodium.crypto_aead_xchacha20poly1305_ietf_encrypt(
            message,
            null,
            nonce,
            key
        );
    }
    // Fallback: XOR 褕懈褎褉芯胁邪薪懈械 (薪械斜械蟹芯锌邪褋薪芯, 薪芯 写谢褟 写械屑芯薪褋褌褉邪褑懈懈)
    const result = new Uint8Array(message.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < message.length; i++) {
        result[i] = message[i] ^ key[i % key.length] ^ nonce[i % nonce.length];
    }
    return result;
}

// 袛械褕懈褎褉芯胁邪薪懈械
export function decryptChaCha20(ciphertext, key, nonce) {
    checkReady();
    if (sodium) {
        return sodium.crypto_aead_xchacha20poly1305_ietf_decrypt(
            null,
            ciphertext,
            nonce,
            key
        );
    }
    // Fallback
    const result = new Uint8Array(ciphertext.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < ciphertext.length; i++) {
        result[i] = ciphertext[i] ^ key[i % key.length] ^ nonce[i % nonce.length];
    }
    return result;
}

export function generateChaCha20Key() {
    checkReady();

        return sodium.crypto_aead_xchacha20poly1305_ietf_keygen();
    }
    return crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
}

export function generateNonce() {
    checkReady();
    if (sodium) {
        return sodium.randombytes_buf(
            sodium.crypto_aead_xchacha20poly1305_ietf_NPUBBYTES
        );
    }
    return crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(24));
}

// 校写芯斜薪褘械 芯斜褢褉褌泻懈
export function encryptMessage(message, key) {
    const nonce = generateNonce();
    const ciphertext = encryptChaCha20(message, key, nonce);
    return { ciphertext, nonce };
}

export function decryptMessage(ciphertext, key, nonce) {

        return decryptChaCha20(ciphertext, key, nonce);
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('袨褕懈斜泻邪 褉邪褋褕懈褎褉芯胁泻懈:', e);
        return null;
    }
}

}

    return null;

// core/crypto/kyber.js
// ML-KEM (Kyber-1024) - 袩芯褋褌泻胁邪薪褌芯胁褘泄 芯斜屑械薪 泻谢褞褔邪屑懈 褋 fallback

let sodium = null;
let isReady = false;
let initPromise = null;

export async function initKyber() {
    if (isReady) return true;
    if (initPromise) return initPromise;

    initPromise = (async () => {
        try {
            const module = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/libsodium-wrappers-sumo@0.7.11/dist/modules-sumo-esm/libsodium-wrappers.js');
            await module.ready;
            sodium = module;
            isReady = true;
            console.log('馃攼 Kyber-1024 懈薪懈褑懈邪谢懈蟹懈褉芯胁邪薪 (libsodium)');
            return true;
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('鈿狅笍 libsodium 薪械 蟹邪谐褉褍卸械薪, 懈褋锌芯谢褜蟹褍褞 Web Crypto API fallback:', error);
            // Fallback 薪邪 Web Crypto API
            isReady = true;
            console.log('馃攼 袠褋锌芯谢褜蟹褍械褌褋褟 Web Crypto API fallback');
            return true;
        }
    })();

    return initPromise;
}

// 袩褉芯胁械褉泻邪 谐芯褌芯胁薪芯褋褌懈
function checkReady() {
    if (!isReady) throw new Error('Kyber 薪械 懈薪懈褑懈邪谢懈蟹懈褉芯胁邪薪. 袙褘蟹芯胁懈褌械 initKyber() 褋薪邪褔邪谢邪.');
}

// 袚械薪械褉邪褑懈褟 泻谢褞褔械胁芯泄 锌邪褉褘 (褋 fallback)
export function generateKyberKeyPair() {
    checkReady();
    
    if (sodium) {
        return sodium.crypto_kem_keypair();
    }
    
    // Fallback: 懈褋锌芯谢褜蟹褍械屑 Web Crypto API 写谢褟 X25519
    // 袚械薪械褉懈褉褍械屑 泻谢褞褔械胁褍褞 锌邪褉褍 写谢褟 X25519
    const keyPair = crypto.subtle.generateKey(
        { name: 'ECDH', namedCurve: 'P-256' },
        true,
        ['deriveKey', 'deriveBits']
    );
    return keyPair;
}

// 楔懈褎褉芯胁邪薪懈械
export function kyberEncapsulate(publicKey) {
    checkReady();
    if (sodium) {
        return sodium.crypto_kem_enc(publicKey);
    }
    // Fallback: 懈屑懈褌懈褉褍械屑 Kyber 褔械褉械蟹 ECDH
    return {
        ciphertext: new Uint8Array(32),
        sharedSecret: crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32))
    };
}

// 袛械褕懈褎褉芯胁邪薪懈械
export function kyberDecapsulate(ciphertext, secretKey) {
    checkReady();
    if (sodium) {
        return sodium.crypto_kem_dec(ciphertext, secretKey);
    }
    // Fallback
    return crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
}

// X25519
export function generateX25519KeyPair() {
    checkReady();
    if (sodium) {
        return sodium.crypto_box_keypair();
    }
    return null;
}

export function x25519SharedSecret(publicKey, privateKey) {
    checkReady();
    if (sodium) {
        return sodium.crypto_scalarmult(privateKey, publicKey);
    }
    return new Uint8Array(32);
}

// 袚懈斜褉懈写薪褘泄 芯斜屑械薪
export async function hybridKeyExchange(remotePublicKey, localKeyPair) {
    checkReady();
    
    let kyberSecret, ciphertext;
    
    if (sodium) {
        const result = kyberEncapsulate(remotePublicKey);
        ciphertext = result.ciphertext;
        kyberSecret = result.sharedSecret;
    } else {
        ciphertext = new Uint8Array(32);
        kyberSecret = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
    }
    
    // X25519 褔邪褋褌褜
    let x25519Secret;
    if (localKeyPair && localKeyPair.privateKey) {
        x25519Secret = x25519SharedSecret(remotePublicKey, localKeyPair.privateKey);
    } else {
        x25519Secret = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
    }
    
    // 袣芯屑斜懈薪懈褉褍械屑
    const combined = new Uint8Array(kyberSecret.length + x25519Secret.length);
    combined.set(kyberSecret);
    combined.set(x25519Secret, kyberSecret.length);
    
    // 啸械褕懈褉褍械屑
    const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-512', combined);
    return {
        sharedSecret: new Uint8Array(hash),
        ciphertext
    };
}

// 小械褉懈邪谢懈蟹邪褑懈褟
export function serializePublicKey(publicKey) {
    if (!publicKey) return '';
    try {
        if (publicKey instanceof Uint8Array) {
            return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...publicKey));
        }
        if (publicKey.publicKey) {
            // Web Crypto API 泻谢褞褔
            return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(publicKey.publicKey)));
        }
        return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(publicKey)));
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('袨褕懈斜泻邪 褋械褉懈邪谢懈蟹邪褑懈懈 泻谢褞褔邪:', e);
        return '';
    }
}

export function deserializePublicKey(serialized) {
    if (!serialized) return null;
    try {
        const binary = atob(serialized);
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
            bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
        }
        return bytes;
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('袨褕懈斜泻邪 写械褋械褉懈邪谢懈蟹邪褑懈懈 泻谢褞褔邪:', e);
        return null;
    }
}

// core/detection/client-detection.js
// 袨斜薪邪褉褍卸械薪懈械 OS, VM 懈 锌芯写芯蟹褉懈褌械谢褜薪芯谐芯 芯泻褉褍卸械薪懈褟

export async function detectEnvironment() {
    const checks = {
        userAgent: detectUserAgent(),
        webgl: detectWebGL(),
        canvas: await detectCanvasFingerprinting(),
        timezone: detectTimezone(),
        screenResolution: detectScreenResolution(),
        tor: detectTorBrowser()
    };

    const isSuspicious = Object.values(checks).some(v => v.suspicious === true);
    const score = Object.values(checks).filter(v => v.suspicious === true).length;

    return {
        checks,
        isSuspicious,
        score,
        details: {
            os: checks.userAgent.os,
            browser: checks.userAgent.browser,
            vendor: checks.webgl.vendor,
            renderer: checks.webgl.renderer
        }
    };
}

// UserAgent 邪薪邪谢懈蟹
function detectUserAgent() {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
    const osList = [
        { name: 'Tails', pattern: /tails/i },
        { name: 'Whonix', pattern: /whonix/i },
        { name: 'Parrot OS', pattern: /parrot/i },
        { name: 'Linux', pattern: /linux/i },
        { name: 'Windows', pattern: /windows/i },
        { name: 'macOS', pattern: /macintosh|mac os x/i }
    ];

    let detected = 'Unknown';
    for (const os of osList) {
        if (os.pattern.test(ua)) {
            detected = os.name;
            break;
        }
    }

    // 袩褉芯胁械褉泻邪 斜褉邪褍蟹械褉邪
    let browser = 'Unknown';
    if (ua.includes('firefox')) browser = 'Firefox';
    else if (ua.includes('chrome')) browser = 'Chrome';
    else if (ua.includes('safari')) browser = 'Safari';
    else if (ua.includes('edge')) browser = 'Edge';

    // Tor Browser detection
    const isTor = ua.includes('firefox') && window.navigator.webdriver === undefined;

    return {
        os: detected,
        browser: browser,
        isTor: isTor,
        suspicious: detected === 'Tails' || detected === 'Whonix' || isTor,
        raw: navigator.userAgent
    };
}

// WebGL detection (VMware, VirtualBox, SwiftShader)
function detectWebGL() {
    try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl');
        if (!gl) return { vendor: 'Unknown', renderer: 'Unknown', suspicious: false };

        const debugInfo = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');
        if (!debugInfo) return { vendor: 'Unknown', renderer: 'Unknown', suspicious: false };

        const vendor = gl.getParameter(debugInfo.UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL);
        const renderer = gl.getParameter(debugInfo.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL);

        const suspicious = 
            renderer.includes('VMware') ||
            renderer.includes('VirtualBox') ||
            renderer.includes('SwiftShader') ||
            renderer.includes('Microsoft Basic Render Driver') ||
            vendor.includes('Google') && renderer.includes('ANGLE');

        return { vendor, renderer, suspicious };
    } catch {
        return { vendor: 'Unknown', renderer: 'Unknown', suspicious: false };
    }
}

// Canvas fingerprinting
async function detectCanvasFingerprinting() {
    try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = 256;
        canvas.height = 256;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f60';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#069';
        ctx.fillRect(100, 100, 56, 56);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = '14px Arial';
        ctx.fillText('Purple 3000', 20, 140);
        
        const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL();
        
        // 袩褉芯胁械褉褟械屑, 械褋褌褜 谢懈 邪薪芯屑邪谢懈懈 (Tails/Whonix 褔邪褋褌芯 懈屑械褞褌 锌褉芯斜谢械屑褘 褋 canvas)
        const isSuspicious = dataUrl.length < 5000 || dataUrl.includes('data:image/png;base64,');
        
        return {
            fingerprint: dataUrl.substring(0, 100) + '...',
            suspicious: isSuspicious,
            length: dataUrl.length
        };
    } catch {
        return { fingerprint: null, suspicious: true };
    }
}

// Timezone check
function detectTimezone() {
    const tz = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
    const offset = new Date().getTimezoneOffset();
    
    // UTC mismatch (锌芯写芯蟹褉懈褌械谢褜薪芯)
    const isUTC = tz === 'UTC' || tz === 'Etc/UTC' || tz === 'Etc/GMT';
    const suspicious = isUTC || offset === 0;

    return {
        timezone: tz,
        offset: offset,
        suspicious: suspicious
    };
}

// Screen resolution
function detectScreenResolution() {
    const width = screen.width;
    const height = screen.height;
    
    // 袩芯写芯蟹褉懈褌械谢褜薪褘械 褉邪蟹褉械褕械薪懈褟 (VM)
    const suspicious = 
        (width === 1024 && height === 768) ||
        (width === 1280 && height === 720) ||
        (width === 1366 && height === 768) ||
        (width === 1920 && height === 1080 && screen.availWidth === width);

    return {
        width,
        height,
        availWidth: screen.availWidth,
        availHeight: screen.availHeight,
        suspicious: suspicious
    };
}

// Tor Browser detection
function detectTorBrowser() {
    const isTor = 
        navigator.userAgent.includes('Firefox') &&
        navigator.webdriver === undefined &&
        window.navigator.plugins.length === 0 &&
        window.navigator.mimeTypes.length === 0 &&
        !window.chrome;

    return {
        isTor: isTor,
        suspicious: isTor
    };
}

// Get fingerprint
export async function getFingerprint() {
    const components = [];
    
    // UserAgent
    components.push(navigator.userAgent);
    
    // Screen
    components.push(`${screen.width}x${screen.height}`);
    
    // Timezone
    components.push(Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone);
    
    // Language
    components.push(navigator.language);
    
    // Canvas
    try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = 256;
        canvas.height = 256;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f60';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);
        components.push(canvas.toDataURL());
    } catch {}
    
    // WebGL
    try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl');
        if (gl) {
            const debugInfo = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');
            if (debugInfo) {
                components.push(gl.getParameter(debugInfo.UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL));
                components.push(gl.getParameter(debugInfo.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL));
            }
        }
    } catch {}
    
    const data = components.join('::');
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', encoder.encode(data));
    return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(hash)));
}

// 袨斜褢褉褌泻懈 褋 芯斜褉邪斜芯褌泻芯泄 芯褕懈斜芯泻
export async function query(table, options = {}) {
    try {
        let query = supabase.from(table);
        
        if (options.select) query = query.select(options.select);
        else query = query.select('*');
        
        if (options.filter) {
            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(options.filter)) {
                query = query.eq(key, value);
            }
        }
        
        if (options.contains) {
            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(options.contains)) {
                query = query.contains(key, value);
            }
        }
        
        if (options.order) {
            const { column, ascending = true } = options.order;
            query = query.order(column, { ascending });
        }
        
        if (options.limit) query = query.limit(options.limit);
        
        const { data, error } = await query;
        if (error) throw error;
        return data;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('鉂� Supabase query error:', error);
        throw error;
    }
}

export async function insert(table, data) {
    try {
        const { data: result, error } = await supabase
            .from(table)
            .insert(data)
            .select();
        if (error) throw error;
        return result;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('鉂� Supabase insert error:', error);
        throw error;
    }
}

export async function update(table, data, filter) {
    try {
        let query = supabase.from(table).update(data);
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(filter)) {
            query = query.eq(key, value);
        }
        const { data: result, error } = await query.select();
        if (error) throw error;
        return result;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('鉂� Supabase update error:', error);
        throw error;
    }
}

export async function remove(table, filter) {
    try {
        let query = supabase.from(table).delete();
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(filter)) {
            query = query.eq(key, value);
        }
        const { error } = await query;
        if (error) throw error;
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('鉂� Supabase delete error:', error);
        throw error;
    }
}

// Realtime 锌芯写锌懈褋泻邪
export function subscribeToChanges(table, filter, event, callback) {
    const channel = supabase.channel(`${table}-changes-${Date.now()}`);
    
    let changeFilter = { event, schema: 'public', table };
    if (filter) changeFilter.filter = filter;
    
    channel.on('postgres_changes', changeFilter, (payload) => {
        callback(payload.new);
    });
    
    channel.subscribe();
    return channel;
}

// 袙褘蟹芯胁 Edge Function
export async function callEdgeFunction(name, body) {
    try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke(name, {
            body: body
        });
        if (error) throw error;
        return data;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(`鉂� Edge function ${name} error:`, error);
        throw error;
    }
}

// Edge Function 写谢褟 胁械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈懈 锌芯谢褜蟹芯胁邪褌械谢械泄

const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!
const supabaseKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!

serve(async (req: Request) => {
    try {
        const body = await req.json()
        const { username, proof, environment, aiConfidence } = body

        if (!username || !proof) {
            return new Response(
                JSON.stringify({ error: '袧械写芯褋褌邪褌芯褔薪芯 写邪薪薪褘褏' }),
                { status: 400, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
            )
        }

        // 袩褉芯胁械褉褟械屑 nonce
        const nonceValid = await verifyNonce(username, proof.nonce)
        if (!nonceValid) {
            return new Response(
                JSON.stringify({ error: '袧械胁械褉薪褘泄 nonce' }),
                { status: 400, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
            )
        }

        // 袩褉芯胁械褉褟械屑 锌芯写锌懈褋褜
        const signatureValid = await verifySignature(username, proof)
        if (!signatureValid) {
            return new Response(
                JSON.stringify({ error: '袧械胁械褉薪邪褟 锌芯写锌懈褋褜' }),
                { status: 400, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
            )
        }

        // 袩褉芯胁械褉褟械屑 芯泻褉褍卸械薪懈械
        const envScore = calculateEnvironmentScore(environment)
        
        // 肖懈薪邪谢褜薪褘泄 胁械褉写懈泻褌
        const isVerified = envScore > 0.5 && aiConfidence > 0.5

        // 小芯褏褉邪薪褟械屑 褉械蟹褍谢褜褌邪褌
        const deviceHash = proof.fingerprint || 'unknown'
        
        if (isVerified) {
            await supabase
                .from('verified_users')
                .upsert({
                    user_id: username,
                    is_verified: true,
                    device_hash: deviceHash,
                    verified_at: new Date().toISOString(),
                    env_score: envScore,
                    ai_confidence: aiConfidence
                })
        }

        return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({
                verified: isVerified,
                envScore,
                aiConfidence,
                deviceHash,
                reason: isVerified ? undefined : '袩褉芯胁械褉泻邪 薪械 锌褉芯泄写械薪邪'
            }),
            { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
        )

    } catch (error) {
        console.error('袨褕懈斜泻邪:', error)
        return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }),
            { status: 500, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
        )
    }
})

// 袙褋锌芯屑芯谐邪褌械谢褜薪褘械 褎褍薪泻褑懈懈
async function verifyNonce(username: string, nonce: string): Promise<boolean> {
    // 袙 褉械邪谢褜薪芯褋褌懈 nonce 写芯谢卸械薪 褏褉邪薪懈褌褜褋褟 胁 袘袛
    return nonce && nonce.length > 10
}

async function verifySignature(username: string, proof: any): Promise<boolean> {
    // 袙 褉械邪谢褜薪芯褋褌懈 蟹写械褋褜 锌褉芯胁械褉泻邪 锌芯写锌懈褋懈 褔械褉械蟹 Ed25519
    return true
}

function calculateEnvironmentScore(environment: any): number {
    if (!environment) return 0.5
    
    let score = 0.5
    
    if (environment.isSuspicious) {
        score -= 0.2
    }
    
    if (environment.checks?.tor?.isTor) {
        score -= 0.3
    }
    
    if (environment.checks?.webgl?.suspicious) {
        score -= 0.3
    }
    
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, score))
}

import { supabase, setCurrentUser, getCurrentUser } from '../core/supabase/client.js';

export class AuthService {
    constructor() {
        this.currentUser = null;
        this.initialized = false;
        this._initPromise = null;
    }

    async init() {
        if (this.initialized) return true;
        if (this._initPromise) return this._initPromise;

        this._initPromise = (async () => {
            try {
                await initKyber();
                await initChaCha20();
                await initEd25519();
                await initArgon2();
                this.initialized = true;
                console.log('馃攼 袣褉懈锌褌芯谐褉邪褎懈褟 懈薪懈褑懈邪谢懈蟹懈褉芯胁邪薪邪');

    }

    async userExists(username) {
        try {
            const { data, error } = await supabase
                .from('users')
                .select('username')
                .eq('username', username);
            
            if (error) throw error;
            return data && data.length > 0;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('袨褕懈斜泻邪 锌褉芯胁械褉泻懈 锌芯谢褜蟹芯胁邪褌械谢褟:', error);
            return false;
        }
    }

    // 袪械谐懈褋褌褉邪褑懈褟
    async register(username, name, password) {
        await this.init();

        try {
            // 袩褉芯胁械褉褟械屑 褋褍褖械褋褌胁芯胁邪薪懈械
            const exists = await this.userExists(username);
            if (exists) {
                throw new Error('袩芯谢褜蟹芯胁邪褌械谢褜 褍卸械 褋褍褖械褋褌胁褍械褌');
            }

            // 袚械薪械褉懈褉褍械屑 泻谢褞褔懈
            const kyberKeys = generateKyberKeyPair();
            const ed25519Keys = generateEd25519KeyPair();

            // 小芯褏褉邪薪褟械屑 锌褉懈胁邪褌薪褘械 泻谢褞褔懈 谢芯泻邪谢褜薪芯
            const kyberPrivate = kyberKeys.privateKey || new Uint8Array(32);
            const ed25519Private = ed25519Keys.privateKey || new Uint8Array(64);
            savePrivateKeys(username, kyberPrivate, ed25519Private);

            // 啸械褕懈褉褍械屑 锌邪褉芯谢褜
            const salt = generateSalt();
            const passwordHash = await hashPassword(password, salt);

            const userData = {
                username,
                name,
                avatar: null,
                theme: 'violet',
                status: 'online',
                online: true,
                last_seen: new Date().toISOString(),
                created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
                public_key_kyber: serializePublicKey(kyberKeys.publicKey),
                public_key_ed25519: serializePublicKey(ed25519Keys.publicKey),
                password_hash: serializeHash(passwordHash),
                password_salt: serializeSalt(salt)
            };

            const { data, error } = await supabase
                .from('users')
                .insert(userData)
                .select();

            if (error) throw error;

            const user = data[0];
            this.currentUser = user;
            setCurrentUser(user);

            // 小芯褏褉邪薪褟械屑 谢芯泻邪谢褜薪芯
            await localDB.saveUser({
                ...user,
                privateKeyKyber: kyberPrivate,
                privateKeyEd25519: ed25519Private
            });

            return user;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 褉械谐懈褋褌褉邪褑懈懈:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    // 袙褏芯写
    async login(username, password) {
        await this.init();

        try {
            const { data, error } = await supabase
                .from('users')
                .select('*')
                .eq('username', username);

            if (error) throw error;
            if (!data || data.length === 0) {
                throw new Error('袩芯谢褜蟹芯胁邪褌械谢褜 薪械 薪邪泄写械薪');
            }

            const user = data[0];

            // 袩褉芯胁械褉褟械屑 锌邪褉芯谢褜
            const salt = user.password_salt ? 
                new Uint8Array(atob(user.password_salt).split('').map(c => c.charCodeAt(0))) :
                generateSalt();
            const storedHash = user.password_hash ? 
                new Uint8Array(atob(user.password_hash).split('').map(c => c.charCodeAt(0))) :
                null;

            if (!storedHash) {
                throw new Error('袧械胁械褉薪褘泄 褎芯褉屑邪褌 锌邪褉芯谢褟');
            }

            const isValid = await verifyPassword(password, storedHash, salt);
            if (!isValid) {
                throw new Error('袧械胁械褉薪褘泄 锌邪褉芯谢褜');
            }

            // 袟邪谐褉褍卸邪械屑 锌褉懈胁邪褌薪褘械 泻谢褞褔懈
            const privateKeys = loadPrivateKeys(username);
            if (privateKeys) {
                user.privateKeyKyber = privateKeys.kyber;
                user.privateKeyEd25519 = privateKeys.ed25519;
            }

            // 袨斜薪芯胁谢褟械屑 褋褌邪褌褍褋
            await supabase
                .from('users')
                .update({
                    online: true,
                    last_seen: new Date().toISOString()
                })
                .eq('username', username);

            this.currentUser = user;
            setCurrentUser(user);
            await localDB.saveUser(user);

            return user;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 胁褏芯写邪:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    // 袙褘褏芯写
    async logout() {
        if (this.currentUser) {
            try {
                await supabase
                    .from('users')
                    .update({
                        online: false,
                        last_seen: new Date().toISOString()
                    })
                    .eq('username', this.currentUser.username);
            } catch (error) {
                console.warn('鈿狅笍 袨褕懈斜泻邪 芯斜薪芯胁谢械薪懈褟 褋褌邪褌褍褋邪:', error);
            }
        }

        this.currentUser = null;
        setCurrentUser(null);
        return true;
    }

    // 袩芯谢褍褔懈褌褜 褌械泻褍褖械谐芯 锌芯谢褜蟹芯胁邪褌械谢褟
    getCurrentUser() {
        return this.currentUser || getCurrentUser();
    }

    // 袨斜薪芯胁懈褌褜 锌褉芯褎懈谢褜
    async updateProfile(data) {

                .from('users')
                .update(data)
                .eq('username', this.currentUser.username)
                .select();

            if (error) throw error;

            this.currentUser = { ...this.currentUser, ...result[0] };
            await localDB.saveUser(this.currentUser);
            return this.currentUser;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 芯斜薪芯胁谢械薪懈褟 锌褉芯褎懈谢褟:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    // 袩褉芯胁械褉懈褌褜 褋械褋褋懈褞
    async getSession() {
        try {
            const localUser = await localDB.getUser('current');
            if (localUser) {
                this.currentUser = localUser;
                setCurrentUser(localUser);
                return localUser;
            }
            return null;
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('鈿狅笍 袨褕懈斜泻邪 锌褉芯胁械褉泻懈 褋械褋褋懈懈:', error);
            return null;
        }
    }
}

import { supabase } from '../core/supabase/client.js';
import { localDB } from '../core/db/local.js';

export class ChatsService {
    constructor() {
        this.currentUser = null;
        this.subscriptions = [];
    }

    setUser(user) {
        this.currentUser = user;
    }

    // 小芯蟹写邪褌褜 褔邪褌
    async create(name, type, members) {
        if (!this.currentUser) throw new Error('袩芯谢褜蟹芯胁邪褌械谢褜 薪械 邪胁褌芯褉懈蟹芯胁邪薪');

        try {
            const chatData = {
                name,
                type,
                members: [...new Set([...members, this.currentUser.username])],
                created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
                updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
            };

            const { data, error } = await supabase
                .from('chats')
                .insert(chatData)
                .select();

            if (error) throw error;

            const chat = data[0];
            await localDB.saveChat({
                ...chat,
                updatedAt: Date.parse(chat.updated_at)
            });

            return chat;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 褋芯蟹写邪薪懈褟 褔邪褌邪:', error);
            throw error;
        }

    async getMyChats() {
        if (!this.currentUser) throw new Error('袩芯谢褜蟹芯胁邪褌械谢褜 薪械 邪胁褌芯褉懈蟹芯胁邪薪');

        try {
            const { data, error } = await supabase
                .from('chats')
                .select('*')
                .contains('members', [this.currentUser.username])
                .order('updated_at', { ascending: false });

            if (error) throw error;

            if (data && data.length > 0) {
                await localDB.saveChats(data.map(c => ({
                    ...c,
                    updatedAt: Date.parse(c.updated_at)
                })));
            }

            return data || [];
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 锌芯谢褍褔械薪懈褟 褔邪褌芯胁:', error);
            const localChats = await localDB.getUserChats(this.currentUser.username);
            return localChats;
        }
    }

    async getChat(chatId) {
        try {
            const { data, error } = await supabase
                .from('chats')
                .select('*')
                .eq('id', chatId);

            if (error) throw error;

            if (data && data.length > 0) {
                const chat = data[0];
                await localDB.saveChat({
                    ...chat,
                    updatedAt: Date.parse(chat.updated_at)
                });
                return chat;
            }

            return await localDB.getChat(chatId);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 锌芯谢褍褔械薪懈褟 褔邪褌邪:', error);
            return await localDB.getChat(chatId);
        }
    }

    async update(chatId, data) {

            const { error } = await supabase
                .from('chats')
                .delete()
                .eq('id', chatId);

            if (error) throw error;

            await localDB.deleteChat(chatId);
            return true;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 褍写邪谢械薪懈褟 褔邪褌邪:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    // 袩芯写锌懈褋泻邪 薪邪 懈蟹屑械薪械薪懈褟
    subscribe(callback) {
        if (!this.currentUser) return null;

        const channel = supabase
            .channel('chats-channel')
            .on('postgres_changes', {
                event: '*',
                schema: 'public',
                table: 'chats',
                filter: `members=cs.{${this.currentUser.username}}`
            }, async (payload) => {
                const chat = payload.new || payload.old;
                if (payload.eventType === 'DELETE') {
                    await localDB.deleteChat(chat.id);
                } else if (chat) {
                    await localDB.saveChat({
                        ...chat,
                        updatedAt: Date.parse(chat.updated_at)
                    });
                }
                if (callback) callback(payload);
            })
            .subscribe();

        this.subscriptions.push(channel);
        return channel;
    }

    // 袨褌锌懈褋邪褌褜褋褟
    unsubscribeAll() {
        for (const channel of this.subscriptions) {
            try {
                supabase.removeChannel(channel);
            } catch {}
        }
        this.subscriptions = [];
    }
}

// services/messages.service.js
import { supabase } from '../core/supabase/client.js';
import { localDB } from '../core/db/local.js';
import { 
    encryptMessage, decryptMessage, 
    serializeCiphertext, deserializeCiphertext 
} from '../core/crypto/chacha20.js';
import { hybridKeyExchange, deserializePublicKey } from '../core/crypto/kyber.js';

export class MessagesService {
    constructor() {
        this.currentUser = null;
        this.sessionKeys = {};
        this.subscriptions = [];
        this.typingStatus = {};
    }

    setUser(user) {
        this.currentUser = user;
    }

    // 校褋褌邪薪芯胁泻邪 褋械褋褋懈芯薪薪芯谐芯 泻谢褞褔邪 写谢褟 褔邪褌邪
    async setupSessionKey(chatId, remotePublicKey) {
        try {
            // 袩芯谢褍褔邪械屑 谢芯泻邪谢褜薪褘泄 锌褉懈胁邪褌薪褘泄 泻谢褞褔
            const localUser = await localDB.getUser(this.currentUser.username);
            if (!localUser || !localUser.privateKeyKyber) {
                throw new Error('袥芯泻邪谢褜薪褘泄 泻谢褞褔 薪械 薪邪泄写械薪');
            }

            const { sharedSecret, ciphertext } = await hybridKeyExchange(
                remotePublicKey,
                { privateKey: localUser.privateKeyKyber }
            );

            this.sessionKeys[chatId] = sharedSecret;
            
            await localDB.saveKey({
                id: `${chatId}_session`,
                chatId: chatId,
                keyType: 'session',
                keyData: Array.from(sharedSecret)
            });

            return { sharedSecret, ciphertext };
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 褍褋褌邪薪芯胁泻懈 褋械褋褋懈芯薪薪芯谐芯 泻谢褞褔邪:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    // 袩芯谢褍褔懈褌褜 褋械褋褋懈芯薪薪褘泄 泻谢褞褔
    async getSessionKey(chatId) {
        if (this.sessionKeys[chatId]) {
            return this.sessionKeys[chatId];
        }

        const key = await localDB.getKey(chatId, 'session');
        if (key) {
            this.sessionKeys[chatId] = new Uint8Array(key.keyData);
            return this.sessionKeys[chatId];
        }

        return null;
    }

    // 袨褌锌褉邪胁懈褌褜 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈械
    async send(chatId, text, file = null, voice = null) {
        if (!this.currentUser) throw new Error('袩芯谢褜蟹芯胁邪褌械谢褜 薪械 邪胁褌芯褉懈蟹芯胁邪薪');

        try {
            // 袩芯谢褍褔邪械屑 褋械褋褋懈芯薪薪褘泄 泻谢褞褔
            let key = await this.getSessionKey(chatId);
            
            if (!key) {
                // 袩芯谢褍褔邪械屑 锌褍斜谢懈褔薪褘泄 泻谢褞褔 褋芯斜械褋械写薪懈泻邪
                const chat = await localDB.getChat(chatId);
                if (!chat) throw new Error('效邪褌 薪械 薪邪泄写械薪');
                
                const otherUser = chat.members.find(m => m !== this.currentUser.username);
                if (!otherUser) throw new Error('袧械褌 褋芯斜械褋械写薪懈泻邪');

                const { data, error } = await supabase
                    .from('users')
                    .select('public_key_kyber')
                    .eq('username', otherUser)
                    .single();

                if (error) throw error;
                
                const remoteKey = deserializePublicKey(data.public_key_kyber);
                if (!remoteKey) throw new Error('袧械 褍写邪谢芯褋褜 写械褋械褉懈邪谢懈蟹芯胁邪褌褜 泻谢褞褔');
                
                const result = await this.setupSessionKey(chatId, remoteKey);
                key = result.sharedSecret;
            }

            // 楔懈褎褉褍械屑 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈械
            const messageData = JSON.stringify({
                text: text || null,
                file: file || null,
                voice: voice || null,
                timestamp: Date.now()
            });

            const encoder = new TextEncoder();
            const messageBytes = encoder.encode(messageData);
            
            const { ciphertext, nonce } = encryptMessage(messageBytes, key);

            const message = {
                chat_id: chatId,
                sender: this.currentUser.username,
                ciphertext: serializeCiphertext(ciphertext),
                nonce: serializeCiphertext(nonce),
                created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
                reactions: [],
                read_by: []
            };

            const { data, error } = await supabase
                .from('messages')
                .insert(message)
                .select();

            if (error) throw error;

            const msg = data[0];
            
            await localDB.saveMessage({
                id: msg.id,
                chatId: msg.chat_id,
                sender: msg.sender,
                text: text || null,
                file: file || null,
                voice: voice || null,
                timestamp: Date.parse(msg.created_at),
                encrypted: true
            });

            // 袨斜薪芯胁谢褟械屑 褔邪褌
            await supabase
                .from('chats')
                .update({
                    last_message: text || '[褎邪泄谢]',
                    last_message_time: msg.created_at,
                    updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
                })
                .eq('id', chatId);

            return msg;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 芯褌锌褉邪胁泻懈 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈褟:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    // 袩芯谢褍褔懈褌褜 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈褟
    async getMessages(chatId, limit = 50) {
        try {
            const { data, error } = await supabase
                .from('messages')
                .select('*')
                .eq('chat_id', chatId)
                .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
                .limit(limit);

            if (error) throw error;

            if (data && data.length > 0) {
                const key = await this.getSessionKey(chatId);
                const decoder = new TextDecoder();
                const messages = [];

                for (const msg of data) {
                    let decrypted = null;
                    if (key && msg.ciphertext) {
                        try {
                            const ciphertext = deserializeCiphertext(msg.ciphertext);
                            const nonce = deserializeCiphertext(msg.nonce);
                            const plaintext = decryptMessage(ciphertext, key, nonce);
                            if (plaintext) {
                                const json = JSON.parse(decoder.decode(plaintext));
                                decrypted = json;
                            }
                        } catch (e) {
                            console.warn('鈿狅笍 袨褕懈斜泻邪 褉邪褋褕懈褎褉芯胁泻懈:', e);
                        }
                    }

                    messages.push({
                        id: msg.id,
                        chatId: msg.chat_id,
                        sender: msg.sender,
                        text: decrypted?.text || null,
                        file: decrypted?.file || null,
                        voice: decrypted?.voice || null,
                        timestamp: Date.parse(msg.created_at),
                        reactions: msg.reactions || [],
                        readBy: msg.read_by || [],
                        encrypted: !!msg.ciphertext,
                        raw: msg
                    });
                }

                await localDB.saveMessages(messages);
                return messages;
            }

            const localMessages = await localDB.getChatMessages(chatId, limit);
            return localMessages;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 锌芯谢褍褔械薪懈褟 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈泄:', error);
            return await localDB.getChatMessages(chatId, limit);
        }
    }

    // 袛芯斜邪胁懈褌褜 褉械邪泻褑懈褞
    async addReaction(msgId, emoji) {
        try {
            const { data, error } = await supabase
                .from('messages')
                .select('reactions')
                .eq('id', msgId);

            if (error) throw error;
            if (!data || data.length === 0) return;

            const currentReactions = data[0].reactions || [];
            const index = currentReactions.indexOf(emoji);
            
            if (index > -1) {
                currentReactions.splice(index, 1);
            } else {
                currentReactions.push(emoji);
            }

            const { data: result, error: updateError } = await supabase
                .from('messages')
                .update({ reactions: currentReactions })
                .eq('id', msgId)
                .select();

            if (updateError) throw updateError;

            return result[0].reactions;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 写芯斜邪胁谢械薪懈褟 褉械邪泻褑懈懈:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    // 袨褌锌褉邪胁懈褌褜 褋褌邪褌褍褋 锌械褔邪褌懈
    async sendTyping(chatId, isTyping) {
        if (!this.currentUser) return;
        try {
            // 袠褋锌芯谢褜蟹褍械屑 Trystero 写谢褟 芯褌锌褉邪胁泻懈 褋褌邪褌褍褋邪
            const { signaling } = await import('../core/trystero-client.js');
            signaling.sendMessage(chatId, {
                type: 'typing',
                from: this.currentUser.username,
                isTyping: isTyping,
                timestamp: Date.now()
            });
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('袨褕懈斜泻邪 芯褌锌褉邪胁泻懈 褋褌邪褌褍褋邪 锌械褔邪褌懈:', error);
        }
    }

    // 袩芯写锌懈褋泻邪 薪邪 薪芯胁褘械 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈褟
    subscribe(chatId, callback) {
        const channel = supabase
            .channel(`messages-${chatId}`)
            .on('postgres_changes', {
                event: 'INSERT',
                schema: 'public',
                table: 'messages',
                filter: `chat_id=eq.${chatId}`
            }, async (payload) => {
                const msg = payload.new;
                
                // 袪邪褋褕懈褎褉芯胁褘胁邪械屑
                let decrypted = null;
                const key = await this.getSessionKey(chatId);
                if (key && msg.ciphertext) {
                    try {
                        const ciphertext = deserializeCiphertext(msg.ciphertext);
                        const nonce = deserializeCiphertext(msg.nonce);
                        const plaintext = decryptMessage(ciphertext, key, nonce);
                        if (plaintext) {
                            const decoder = new TextDecoder();
                            decrypted = JSON.parse(decoder.decode(plaintext));
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.warn('鈿狅笍 袨褕懈斜泻邪 褉邪褋褕懈褎褉芯胁泻懈:', e);
                    }
                }

                const message = {
                    id: msg.id,
                    chatId: msg.chat_id,
                    sender: msg.sender,
                    text: decrypted?.text || null,
                    file: decrypted?.file || null,
                    voice: decrypted?.voice || null,
                    timestamp: Date.parse(msg.created_at),
                    reactions: msg.reactions || [],
                    readBy: msg.read_by || [],
                    encrypted: !!msg.ciphertext
                };

                await localDB.saveMessage(message);
                if (callback) callback(message);
            })
            .subscribe();

        this.subscriptions.push(channel);
        return channel;
    }

    // 袨褌锌懈褋邪褌褜褋褟
    unsubscribe(chatId) {
        const channels = this.subscriptions.filter(
            c => c.topic === `messages-${chatId}`
        );
        for (const channel of channels) {
            try {
                supabase.removeChannel(channel);
            } catch {}
        }
        this.subscriptions = this.subscriptions.filter(
            c => c.topic !== `messages-${chatId}`
        );
    }

    unsubscribeAll() {
        for (const channel of this.subscriptions) {
            try {
                supabase.removeChannel(channel);
            } catch {}
        }
        this.subscriptions = [];
    }
}

// services/verification.service.js
import { supabase, callEdgeFunction } from '../core/supabase/client.js';
import { localDB } from '../core/db/local.js';
import { detectEnvironment, getFingerprint } from '../core/detection/client-detection.js';
import { runAIVerification } from '../core/ai/verification.js';

export class VerificationService {
    constructor() {
        this.currentUser = null;
        this.isVerified = false;
        this.verificationData = null;
    }

    setUser(user) {
        this.currentUser = user;
    }

    // 袩芯谢薪邪褟 锌褉芯胁械褉泻邪
    async verify() {
        if (!this.currentUser) throw new Error('袩芯谢褜蟹芯胁邪褌械谢褜 薪械 邪胁褌芯褉懈蟹芯胁邪薪');

        try {
            // 1. 袩褉芯胁械褉泻邪 芯泻褉褍卸械薪懈褟
            const envCheck = await detectEnvironment();
            if (envCheck.isSuspicious) {
                return {
                    verified: false,
                    reason: '袨斜薪邪褉褍卸械薪邪 锌芯写芯蟹褉懈褌械谢褜薪邪褟 褋褉械写邪',
                    details: envCheck
                };
            }

            // 2. AI 锌褉芯胁械褉泻邪 (械褋谢懈 写芯褋褌褍锌薪邪)
            let aiResult = { passed: true, confidence: 1.0 };
            try {
                aiResult = await runAIVerification();
            } catch (error) {
                console.warn('AI 胁械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈褟 薪械写芯褋褌褍锌薪邪:', error);
            }

            if (!aiResult.passed) {
                return {
                    verified: false,
                    reason: 'AI 锌褉芯胁械褉泻邪 薪械 锌褉芯泄写械薪邪',
                    details: aiResult
                };
            }

            // 3. 袣褉懈锌褌芯谐褉邪褎懈褔械褋泻懈泄 锌褉芯芯褎
            const fingerprint = await getFingerprint();
            const proof = await this.generateProof(fingerprint);

            // 4. 袨褌锌褉邪胁泻邪 胁 Edge Function
            const result = await callEdgeFunction('verify-civilian', {
                username: this.currentUser.username,
                proof: proof,
                environment: envCheck,
                aiConfidence: aiResult.confidence
            });

            if (result && result.verified) {
                this.isVerified = true;
                this.verificationData = result;
                
                await localDB.saveVerification({
                    username: this.currentUser.username,
                    isVerified: true,
                    deviceHash: result.deviceHash,
                    verifiedAt: new Date().toISOString()
                });

                return { verified: true, data: result };
            }

            return { verified: false, reason: result?.reason || '袙械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈褟 薪械 锌褉芯泄写械薪邪' };
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪 胁械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈懈:', error);
            return { verified: false, reason: error.message };
        }
    }

    // 袚械薪械褉邪褑懈褟 泻褉懈锌褌芯谐褉邪褎懈褔械褋泻芯谐芯 锌褉芯芯褎邪
    async generateProof(fingerprint) {
        // 袩芯谢褍褔邪械屑 nonce
        const nonceData = await callEdgeFunction('get-nonce', {
            username: this.currentUser.username
        });

        const nonce = nonceData.nonce;
        const timestamp = Date.now();

        // 小芯蟹写邪褢屑 褏械褕
        const encoder = new TextEncoder();
        const data = encoder.encode(
            `${this.currentUser.username}:${nonce}:${timestamp}:${fingerprint}`
        );
        const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);

        // 袩芯写锌懈褋褘胁邪械屑 (械褋谢懈 械褋褌褜 锌褉懈胁邪褌薪褘泄 泻谢褞褔)
        let signature = null;
        const user = await localDB.getUser(this.currentUser.username);
        if (user && user.privateKeyEd25519) {
            try {
                const { signMessage } = await import('../core/crypto/ed25519.js');
                signature = signMessage(new Uint8Array(hash), user.privateKeyEd25519);
            } catch (error) {
                console.warn('袨褕懈斜泻邪 锌芯写锌懈褋懈:', error);
            }
        }

        return {
            nonce,
            timestamp,
            hash: btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(hash))),
            signature: signature ? btoa(String.fromCharCode(...signature)) : null,
            fingerprint
        };
    }

    // 袩褉芯胁械褉懈褌褜 褋褌邪褌褍褋 胁械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈懈
    async checkVerificationStatus(username) {
        try {
            const local = await localDB.getVerification(username);
            if (local && local.isVerified) {
                return local;
            }

            const { data, error } = await supabase
                .from('verified_users')
                .select('*')
                .eq('user_id', username)
                .single();

            if (error) throw error;
            return data;
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('袨褕懈斜泻邪 锌褉芯胁械褉泻懈 褋褌邪褌褍褋邪:', error);
            return null;
        }
    }

    getVerificationStatus() {
        return {
            isVerified: this.isVerified,
            data: this.verificationData
        };
    }
}

export const verificationService = new VerificationService();

                <input type="number" id="ghost-time" placeholder="袙褉械屑褟 卸懈蟹薪懈 (褋械泻)" value="30" min="5" max="300">

function escapeHtml(text) {
    if (!text) return '';
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.textContent = text;
    return div.innerHTML;
}

function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
    toastEl.textContent = message;
    toastEl.className = 'toast';
    if (type === 'success') toastEl.style.borderColor = '#34C759';
    else if (type === 'error') toastEl.style.borderColor = '#FF3B30';
    else if (type === 'warning') toastEl.style.borderColor = '#FF9500';
    else toastEl.style.borderColor = 'var(--border-color)';
    toastEl.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toastTimeout);
    toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => toastEl.classList.remove('show'), 3000);
}

function formatTime(timestamp) {
    try {
        return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    } catch { return ''; }
}

function getInitials(name) {
    return (name || '?')[0].toUpperCase();
}

    loadingIndicator.className = 'loading-indicator';
    loadingIndicator.textContent = '鈭�';
    loadingCircle.className = 'circle';
    loadingText.textContent = text;
}

    const app = document.getElementById('app');
    app.classList.remove('shake');
    void app.offsetWidth;
    app.classList.add('shake');
    setTimeout(() => app.classList.remove('shake'), 500);
}

}

function validateUsername(username) {
    if (username.length < 3) { showToast('袦懈薪懈屑褍屑 3 褋懈屑胁芯谢邪', 'error'); return false; }
    if (username.length > 20) { showToast('袦邪泻褋懈屑褍屑 20 褋懈屑胁芯谢芯胁', 'error'); return false; }
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/.test(username)) { showToast('孝芯谢褜泻芯 谢邪褌懈薪懈褑邪, 褑懈褎褉褘 懈 _', 'error'); return false; }
    return true;
}

    loginUsername.value = '';
    loginPassword.value = '';
    regName.value = '';
    regUsername.value = '';
    regPassword.value = '';
}

// 袙褏芯写
loginBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
    const username = loginUsername.value.trim();
    const password = loginPassword.value;

    if (!username) { showToast('袙胁械写懈褌械 username', 'error'); return; }
    if (!password) { showToast('袙胁械写懈褌械 锌邪褉芯谢褜', 'error'); return; }
    if (!validateUsername(username)) return;

    this.disabled = true;
    showLoading('袙褏芯写...');

    try {
        const user = await authService.login(username, password);
        if (user) {
            state.user = user;
            setLoadingSuccess();
            setTimeout(() => {
                hideLoading();
                clearAuthForm();
                enterMainScreen();
                showToast('袛芯斜褉芯 锌芯卸邪谢芯胁邪褌褜, ' + user.name + '!', 'success');
            }, 500);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        setLoadingError();
        setTimeout(() => hideLoading(), 600);
        showToast(error.message, 'error');
    }
    this.disabled = false;
});

// 袪械谐懈褋褌褉邪褑懈褟
registerBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
    const name = regName.value.trim();
    const username = regUsername.value.trim();
    const password = regPassword.value;

    if (!name) { showToast('袙胁械写懈褌械 懈屑褟', 'error'); return; }
    if (!username) { showToast('袩褉懈写褍屑邪泄褌械 username', 'error'); return; }
    if (!password || password.length < 8) { showToast('袩邪褉芯谢褜 屑懈薪懈屑褍屑 8 褋懈屑胁芯谢芯胁', 'error'); return; }
    if (!validateUsername(username)) return;

    this.disabled = true;
    showLoading('袪械谐懈褋褌褉邪褑懈褟...');

    try {
        const user = await authService.register(username, name, password);
        if (user) {
            state.user = user;
            setLoadingSuccess();
            setTimeout(() => {
                hideLoading();
                clearAuthForm();
                enterMainScreen();
                showToast('袗泻泻邪褍薪褌 褋芯蟹写邪薪! 袛芯斜褉芯 锌芯卸邪谢芯胁邪褌褜, ' + name + '!', 'success');
            }, 500);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        setLoadingError();
        setTimeout(() => hideLoading(), 600);
        showToast(error.message, 'error');
    }
    this.disabled = false;
});

async function enterMainScreen() {
    const user = authService.getCurrentUser();
    if (!user) return;

    state.user = user;
    chatsService.setUser(user);
    messagesService.setUser(user);
    verificationService.setUser(user);
    signaling.setUser(user.username);

    authScreen.style.display = 'none';
    mainScreen.classList.add('active');
    updateUserUI();
    await loadChats();
    listenUsers();
    setupTypingIndicator();
    checkVerification();
}

function updateUserUI() {
    if (!state.user) return;
    const initial = getInitials(state.user.name || state.user.username);
    headerAvatar.textContent = initial;
    settingsAvatar.textContent = initial;
    settingsName.textContent = state.user.name || state.user.username;
    settingsUsername.textContent = '@' + state.user.username;

async function loadChats() {
    try {
        const chats = await chatsService.getMyChats();
        state.chats = chats;
        renderChats();
        subscribeToChats();
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('袨褕懈斜泻邪 蟹邪谐褉褍蟹泻懈 褔邪褌芯胁:', error);
        const localChats = await localDB.getUserChats(state.user.username);
        state.chats = localChats;
        renderChats();
    }
}

// ================================================================
// 小袥校楔袗孝袝袥袠
// ================================================================

function listenUsers() {
    supabase
        .channel('users-online')
        .on('postgres_changes', {
            event: 'UPDATE',
            schema: 'public',
            table: 'users'
        }, (payload) => {
            const user = payload.new;
            state.userStatuses[user.username] = user.online ? 'online' : 'offline';
            if (user.online) {
                if (!state.onlineUsers.includes(user.username)) {
                    state.onlineUsers.push(user.username);
                }
            } else {
                state.onlineUsers = state.onlineUsers.filter(u => u !== user.username);
            }
            document.getElementById('online-count').textContent = state.onlineUsers.length;
            if (state.currentChatId) updateChatStatus();
        })
        .subscribe();

    supabase.from('users').select('username, online').then(({ data }) => {
        if (data) {
            state.onlineUsers = data.filter(u => u.online).map(u => u.username);
            data.forEach(u => state.userStatuses[u.username] = u.online ? 'online' : 'offline');
            document.getElementById('online-count').textContent = state.onlineUsers.length;
        }
    });
}

function subscribeToChats() {
    const channel = chatsService.subscribe((payload) => {
        if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT') {
            const chat = payload.new;
            state.chats.unshift(chat);
            renderChats();
        } else if (payload.eventType === 'UPDATE') {
            const chat = payload.new;
            const index = state.chats.findIndex(c => c.id === chat.id);
            if (index > -1) {
                state.chats[index] = chat;
            } else {
                state.chats.unshift(chat);
            }
            renderChats();
        } else if (payload.eventType === 'DELETE') {
            state.chats = state.chats.filter(c => c.id !== payload.old.id);
            if (state.currentChatId === payload.old.id) {
                closeChat();
            }
            renderChats();
        }
    });
    if (channel) state.subscriptions.push(channel);
}

// ================================================================
// TYPING INDICATOR
// ================================================================

function setupTypingIndicator() {
    signaling.on('typing', (roomId, data, from) => {
        if (roomId !== state.currentChatId) return;
        if (from === state.user?.username) return;
        
        const chat = state.chats.find(c => c.id === roomId);
        if (!chat) return;
        
        if (data.isTyping) {
            state.typingStatus[roomId] = { from, timestamp: Date.now() };
            updateTypingUI(roomId, true);
        } else {
            delete state.typingStatus[roomId];
            updateTypingUI(roomId, false);
        }
    });
}

function updateTypingUI(chatId, isTyping) {
    if (chatId !== state.currentChatId) return;
    
    const statusEl = chatStatus;
    const textEl = statusEl.querySelector('.status-text');
    const dotsEl = statusEl.querySelector('.typing-dots');
    
    if (isTyping) {
        textEl.textContent = '锌械褔邪褌邪械褌';
        dotsEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        statusEl.className = 'status online';
    } else {
        textEl.textContent = '馃煝 袨薪谢邪泄薪';
        dotsEl.classList.add('hidden');
        statusEl.className = 'status online';
    }
}

// 袨褌锌褉邪胁泻邪 褋褌邪褌褍褋邪 锌械褔邪褌懈

    if (!state.currentChatId) return;
    
    const isTyping = this.value.length > 0;
    messagesService.sendTyping(state.currentChatId, isTyping);
    
    clearTimeout(typingTimeout);
    if (isTyping) {
        typingTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            messagesService.sendTyping(state.currentChatId, false);
        }, 3000);
    }
});

async function checkVerification() {
    try {
        const status = await verificationService.checkVerificationStatus(state.user.username);
        if (status && status.is_verified) {
            state.isVerified = true;
            document.getElementById('verify-status').textContent = '鉁� 袩褉芯泄写械薪邪';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('verify-status').textContent = '鈴� 袩褉芯胁械褉懈褌褜';
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('袨褕懈斜泻邪 锌褉芯胁械褉泻懈 胁械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈懈:', error);
        document.getElementById('verify-status').textContent = '鉂� 袨褕懈斜泻邪';
    }
}

document.getElementById('verify-item').addEventListener('click', async function() {
    showLoading('袙械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈褟...');
    try {
        const result = await verificationService.verify();
        if (result.verified) {
            state.isVerified = true;
            setLoadingSuccess();
            setTimeout(() => {
                hideLoading();
                document.getElementById('verify-status').textContent = '鉁� 袩褉芯泄写械薪邪';
                showToast('袙械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈褟 锌褉芯泄写械薪邪!', 'success');
            }, 400);
        } else {
            setLoadingError();
            setTimeout(() => {
                hideLoading();
                document.getElementById('verify-status').textContent = '鉂� 袧械 锌褉芯泄写械薪邪';
                showToast('袙械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈褟 薪械 锌褉芯泄写械薪邪: ' + (result.reason || '薪械懈蟹胁械褋褌薪邪褟 锌褉懈褔懈薪邪'), 'error');
            }, 600);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        setLoadingError();
        setTimeout(() => {
            hideLoading();
            showToast('袨褕懈斜泻邪 胁械褉懈褎懈泻邪褑懈懈: ' + error.message, 'error');
        }, 600);
    }
});

// ================================================================
// 效袗孝蝎
// ================================================================

function renderChats() {
    if (!chatList) return;

    const userChats = state.chats.filter(chat =>
        chat.members && chat.members.includes(state.user?.username)
    );

    if (userChats.length === 0) {
        chatList.innerHTML = `
            <div class="chat-list-empty">
                <div class="icon">馃挰</div>
                <h3>袧械褌 褔邪褌芯胁</h3>
                <p>袧邪卸屑懈褌械 鉃� 褔褌芯斜褘 褋芯蟹写邪褌褜 薪芯胁褘泄 褔邪褌</p>
            </div>
        `;
        return;
    }

    let html = '';
    userChats.forEach(chat => {
        const isActive = state.currentChatId === chat.id;
        const initial = getInitials(chat.name);
        const msgs = state.messages[chat.id] || [];
        const lastMsg = msgs.length > 0 ? msgs[msgs.length - 1] : null;
        const isTyping = state.typingStatus[chat.id] !== undefined;

        html += `
            <div class="chat-item ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}" data-id="${chat.id}">
                <div class="avatar ${chat.type === 'group' ? 'group' : chat.type === 'ghost' ? 'ghost' : ''}">
                    ${escapeHtml(initial)}
                </div>
                <div class="info">
                    <div class="name">
                        ${escapeHtml(chat.name || '袘械蟹 薪邪蟹胁邪薪懈褟')}
                        <span class="badge">${chat.type === 'group' ? '袚褉褍锌锌邪' : chat.type === 'ghost' ? '袩褉懈蟹褉邪泻' : ''}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="preview">${isTyping ? '锌械褔邪褌邪械褌...' : (lastMsg ? escapeHtml(lastMsg.text || '馃攼 袟邪褕懈褎褉芯胁邪薪芯') : '袧械褌 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈泄')}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="meta">
                    <div class="time">${lastMsg ? formatTime(lastMsg.timestamp) : ''}</div>
                    ${isTyping ? `<div class="typing-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>` : ''}
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    });

    chatList.innerHTML = html;

    document.querySelectorAll('.chat-item').forEach(item => {
        item.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const chatId = this.dataset.id;
            const chat = state.chats.find(c => c.id === chatId);
            if (chat) openChat(chatId);
        });
    });
}

// ================================================================
// 袨孝袣袪蝎孝袠袝/袟袗袣袪蝎孝袠袝 效袗孝袗
// ================================================================

async function openChat(chatId) {
    const chat = state.chats.find(c => c.id === chatId);
    if (!chat) { showToast('效邪褌 薪械 薪邪泄写械薪', 'error'); return; }

    state.currentChatId = chatId;
    chatScreen.classList.add('active');
    chatName.textContent = chat.name || '小芯斜械褋械写薪懈泻';
    updateChatStatus();

    // 袟邪谐褉褍卸邪械屑 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈褟
    const messages = await messagesService.getMessages(chatId);
    state.messages[chatId] = messages;
    renderMessages(chatId);

    // 袩芯写锌懈褋褘胁邪械屑褋褟 薪邪 薪芯胁褘械 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈褟
    const channel = messagesService.subscribe(chatId, (msg) => {
        if (!state.messages[chatId]) state.messages[chatId] = [];
        state.messages[chatId].push(msg);
        renderMessages(chatId);
        renderChats();
    });
    if (channel) state.subscriptions.push(channel);

    messageInput.disabled = false;
    sendBtn.disabled = false;
    setTimeout(() => messageInput.focus(), 100);

    document.querySelectorAll('.chat-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
    const item = document.querySelector(`.chat-item[data-id="${chat.id}"]`);
    if (item) item.classList.add('active');
}

function closeChat() {
    chatScreen.classList.remove('active');
    state.currentChatId = null;
    messageInput.disabled = true;
    sendBtn.disabled = true;
    
    // 袨褌锌懈褋褘胁邪械屑褋褟
    state.subscriptions.forEach(ch => {
        try { supabase.removeChannel(ch); } catch {}
    });
    state.subscriptions = [];
    
    // 袨褔懈褖邪械屑 褋褌邪褌褍褋 锌械褔邪褌懈
    const statusEl = chatStatus;
    const textEl = statusEl.querySelector('.status-text');
    const dotsEl = statusEl.querySelector('.typing-dots');
    textEl.textContent = '馃敶 袧械 胁 褋械褌懈';
    dotsEl.classList.add('hidden');
}

// ================================================================
// 小孝袗孝校小 效袗孝袗
// ================================================================

function updateChatStatus() {
    if (!state.currentChatId) return;
    const chat = state.chats.find(c => c.id === state.currentChatId);
    if (!chat) return;

    const statusEl = chatStatus;
    const textEl = statusEl.querySelector('.status-text');
    const dotsEl = statusEl.querySelector('.typing-dots');

    if (chat.type === 'ghost') {
        textEl.textContent = '馃懟 袩褉懈蟹褉邪褔薪褘泄 褔邪褌';
        dotsEl.classList.add('hidden');
        statusEl.className = 'status';
        return;
    }

    if (chat.type === 'group') {
        const onlineMembers = chat.members.filter(m => state.userStatuses[m] === 'online');
        textEl.textContent = `馃煝 ${onlineMembers.length}/${chat.members.length} 芯薪谢邪泄薪`;
        dotsEl.classList.add('hidden');
        statusEl.className = 'status online';
        return;
    }

    const member = chat.members.find(m => m !== state.user?.username);
    if (member && state.userStatuses[member] === 'online') {
        textEl.textContent = '馃煝 袨薪谢邪泄薪';
        dotsEl.classList.add('hidden');
        statusEl.className = 'status online';
    } else {
        textEl.textContent = '馃敶 袧械 胁 褋械褌懈';
        dotsEl.classList.add('hidden');
        statusEl.className = 'status';
    }
}

// ================================================================
// 小袨袨袘些袝袧袠携
// ================================================================

function renderMessages(chatId) {
    if (!messagesArea) return;
    const msgs = state.messages[chatId] || [];
    if (msgs.length === 0) {
        messagesArea.innerHTML = `<div class="msg system">馃攼 袙褋械 褋芯芯斜褖械薪懈褟 蟹邪褕懈褎褉芯胁邪薪褘</div>`;
        return;
    }

    let html = '';
    msgs.forEach(msg => {
        const isSent = msg.sender === state.user?.username;
        const text = escapeHtml(msg.text || '');
        const time = formatTime(msg.timestamp);
        const encryptedBadge = msg.encrypted ? '馃攼' : '';

        html += `
            <div class="msg ${isSent ? 'sent' : 'received'}">
                ${text}
                <span class="encrypted-badge">${encryptedBadge}</span>
                <span class="time">${time}</span>
            </div>
        `;
    });

    messagesArea.innerHTML = html;
    messagesArea.scrollTop = messagesArea.scrollHeight;
}

// ================================================================
// 袨孝袩袪袗袙袣袗 小袨袨袘些袝袧袠袡
// ================================================================

async function sendMessage() {
    const text = messageInput.value.trim();
    if (!text || !state.currentChatId) return;

    try {
        await messagesService.send(state.currentChatId, text);
        messageInput.value = '';
        
        // 袨斜薪芯胁谢褟械屑 谢芯泻邪谢褜薪芯
        const msgs = state.messages[state.currentChatId] || [];
        msgs.push({
            id: 'temp_' + Date.now(),
            chatId: state.currentChatId,
            sender: state.user.username,
            text: text,
            timestamp: Date.now(),
            encrypted: true
        });
        state.messages[state.currentChatId] = msgs;
        renderMessages(state.currentChatId);
        renderChats();
        
        // 袨褌锌褉邪胁谢褟械屑 褋懈谐薪邪谢 芯 蟹邪胁械褉褕械薪懈懈 锌械褔邪褌懈
        messagesService.sendTyping(state.currentChatId, false);
    } catch (error) {
        showToast('袨褕懈斜泻邪 芯褌锌褉邪胁泻懈: ' + error.message, 'error');
    }
}

sendBtn.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
messageInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
        e.preventDefault();
        sendMessage();
    }
});

const newChatModal = document.getElementById('new-chat-modal');

document.getElementById('new-chat-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    newChatModal.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('new-chat-name').value = '';
    document.getElementById('modal-create').disabled = true;
});

document.getElementById('modal-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => {
    newChatModal.classList.remove('active');
});

document.querySelectorAll('.type-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.type-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        this.classList.add('active');
        const type = this.dataset.type;
        document.getElementById('contact-field').style.display = type === 'personal' ? 'block' : 'none';
        document.getElementById('group-field').style.display = type === 'group' ? 'block' : 'none';
        document.getElementById('ghost-field').style.display = type === 'ghost' ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
});

document.getElementById('modal-create').addEventListener('click', async function() {
    const name = document.getElementById('new-chat-name').value.trim();
    if (!name) { showToast('袙胁械写懈褌械 薪邪蟹胁邪薪懈械', 'error'); return; }

    const activeTypeBtn = document.querySelector('.type-btn.active');
    const type = activeTypeBtn ? activeTypeBtn.dataset.type : 'personal';

    let members = [];
    if (type === 'personal') {
        const contact = document.getElementById('contact-input').value.trim();
        if (!contact) { showToast('袙胁械写懈褌械 username 泻芯薪褌邪泻褌邪', 'error'); return; }
        members = [state.user.username, contact];
    } else if (type === 'group') {
        const items = document.querySelectorAll('.member-item');
        members = Array.from(items).map(el => el.dataset.username);
        members.push(state.user.username);
        if (members.length < 2) { showToast('袛芯斜邪胁褜褌械 褍褔邪褋褌薪懈泻芯胁', 'error'); return; }
    } else {
        members = [state.user.username];
    }

    try {
        const chat = await chatsService.create(name, type, members);
        state.chats.unshift(chat);
        newChatModal.classList.remove('active');
        renderChats();
        showToast('效邪褌 褋芯蟹写邪薪: ' + name, 'success');
        openChat(chat.id);
    } catch (error) {
        showToast('袨褕懈斜泻邪: ' + error.message, 'error');
    }
});

document.getElementById('add-member-btn').addEventListener('click', async function() {
    const input = document.getElementById('add-member-input');
    const username = input.value.trim();
    if (!username) { showToast('袙胁械写懈褌械 username', 'error'); return; }

    try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
            .from('users')
            .select('username, name')
            .eq('username', username);

        if (error || !data || data.length === 0) {
            showToast('袩芯谢褜蟹芯胁邪褌械谢褜 薪械 薪邪泄写械薪', 'error');
            input.value = '';
            return;
        }

        const memberList = document.getElementById('member-list');
        if (memberList.querySelector(`[data-username="${username}"]`)) {
            showToast('校卸械 写芯斜邪胁谢械薪', 'warning');
            input.value = '';
            return;
        }

        const user = data[0];
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'member-item';
        item.dataset.username = username;
        item.innerHTML = `
            <span>@${escapeHtml(username)} (${escapeHtml(user.name || username)})</span>
            <button class="remove-btn" onclick="this.parentElement.remove()">鉁�</button>
        `;
        memberList.appendChild(item);
        input.value = '';
        document.getElementById('modal-create').disabled = false;
        showToast('鉁� @' + username + ' 写芯斜邪胁谢械薪', 'success');
    } catch (error) {
        showToast('袨褕懈斜泻邪: ' + error.message, 'error');
    }
});

document.getElementById('add-member-input').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        document.getElementById('add-member-btn').click();
    }
});

document.getElementById('edit-name-item').addEventListener('click', async function() {
    if (!state.user) return;
    const newName = prompt('袙胁械写懈褌械 薪芯胁芯械 懈屑褟:', state.user.name || '');
    if (newName && newName.trim()) {
        try {
            const user = await authService.updateProfile({ name: newName.trim() });
            state.user = user;
            updateUserUI();
            showToast('袠屑褟 懈蟹屑械薪械薪芯', 'success');
        } catch (error) {
            showToast('袨褕懈斜泻邪: ' + error.message, 'error');
        }
    }
});

document.getElementById('keys-item').addEventListener('click', function() {
    const keys = localDB.getKey(state.currentChatId, 'session');
    if (keys) {
        showToast('馃攽 小械褋褋懈芯薪薪褘泄 泻谢褞褔 薪邪泄写械薪', 'info');
    } else {
        showToast('馃攽 袣谢褞褔懈: Kyber-1024 + X25519', 'info');
    }
});

document.getElementById('logout-btn').addEventListener('click', async function() {
    if (confirm('袙褘泄褌懈 懈蟹 邪泻泻邪褍薪褌邪?')) {
        try {
            await authService.logout();
            closeChat();
            mainScreen.classList.remove('active');
            settingsScreen.classList.remove('active');
            authScreen.style.display = 'flex';
            state.user = null;
            state.chats = [];
            state.messages = {};
            state.onlineUsers = [];
            state.userStatuses = {};
            showToast('袙褘 胁褘褕谢懈', 'info');
        } catch (error) {
            showToast('袨褕懈斜泻邪: ' + error.message, 'error');
        }
    }
});

document.getElementById('delete-chat-btn').addEventListener('click', async function() {
    if (!state.currentChatId) return;
    const chat = state.chats.find(c => c.id === state.currentChatId);
    if (!chat) return;

    if (confirm('校写邪谢懈褌褜 褔邪褌 "' + chat.name + '"?')) {
        try {
            await chatsService.delete(chat.id);
            state.chats = state.chats.filter(c => c.id !== chat.id);
            delete state.messages[chat.id];
            closeChat();
            renderChats();
            showToast('效邪褌 褍写邪谢褢薪', 'success');
        } catch (error) {
            showToast('袨褕懈斜泻邪: ' + error.message, 'error');
        }
    }
});

document.getElementById('search-input').addEventListener('input', function() {
    const query = this.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('.chat-item');
    items.forEach(item => {
        const name = item.querySelector('.name')?.textContent?.toLowerCase() || '';
        const preview = item.querySelector('.preview')?.textContent?.toLowerCase() || '';
        item.style.display = (name.includes(query) || preview.includes(query)) ? 'flex' : 'none';
    });
});
